options_evaluated: Virgin glass-filled polyamide (PA6-GF30) with overmolded TPE grip
Recycled bio-based polycarbonate/ABS blend with mechanically fastened TPU grip
Monomaterial recycled polypropylene (rPP) with textured grip and mechanical fasteners
assessments.recommendation: Monomaterial recycled polypropylene (rPP) with textured grip and mechanical fasteners
assessments.rationale: This option maximizes the use of recycled materials (h) and significantly improves design for recycling (d) by avoiding multi-material overmolding (like TPE on PA6) which contaminates plastic recycling streams. It also reduces the overall material footprint (o) and supports lightweight design (t) due to the lower density of PP compared to glass-filled polyamides.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (lower impact resistance and structural rigidity compared to glass-filled PA6, potentially reducing the tool's lifespan under harsh drop conditions) and Manufacturing (textured grip requires precise mold design instead of simple overmolding).

options_evaluated: Threaded fasteners directly into plastic bosses using a single screw head type
assessments.recommendation: Threaded fasteners directly into plastic bosses using a single screw head type
assessments.rationale: Using a single type of threaded fastener directly into plastic bosses avoids the use of substances of concern (f) found in structural adhesives and facilitates easy disassembly, directly supporting design for recycling (d). It also reduces the material footprint (o) and weight (t) by eliminating brass threaded inserts or heavy adhesive materials.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (increased assembly time and torque control requirements compared to rapid ultrasonic welding) and Use Phase (screws may back out over time due to motor vibration, reducing structural integrity).

options_evaluated: Brushed DC motor with ferrite magnets and detachable copper windings
Standard brushless DC (BLDC) motor with neodymium magnets
Coreless DC motor with high-density copper coils
assessments.recommendation: Brushed DC motor with ferrite magnets and detachable copper windings
assessments.rationale: This selection minimizes the environmental footprint (m) and material footprint (o) by avoiding rare earth elements (neodymium, dysprosium) which have extremely high environmental impacts during mining and refining. Detachable windings ensure that copper and iron can be easily separated, optimizing the design for recycling (d).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (brushed motors have lower energy efficiency, shorter operational lifespan due to brush wear, and lower power-to-weight ratio, which negatively impacts tool performance and battery run-time).

options_evaluated: Active cooling fan with aluminum heatsink
Passive cooling via ventilation slots and optimized housing geometry
Conductive cooling through phase change materials (PCM) and graphite sheets
assessments.recommendation: Passive cooling via ventilation slots and optimized housing geometry
assessments.rationale: Eliminating dedicated heatsinks and phase change materials minimizes the weight and volume of the product (j), supports lightweight design (t), and reduces the material footprint (o) and environmental footprint (m) by avoiding resource-intensive metals like aluminum or copper.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (higher risk of thermal throttling or overheating under continuous heavy load, which can degrade the motor and battery faster, shortening the product's useful life).

options_evaluated: Fully integrated single-board design with soldered motor and switch
Modular architecture with plug-and-play connectorized sub-assemblies
Partially modular design with soldered wire connections
assessments.recommendation: Modular architecture with plug-and-play connectorized sub-assemblies
assessments.rationale: A modular architecture allows for the easy separation of different material streams (electronics, metals, plastics) at end-of-life, directly serving design for recycling (d). It also facilitates the incorporation of used or reconditioned components (k) in future manufacturing and reduces the material footprint (o) by allowing individual failed modules to be replaced rather than discarding the entire tool.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (higher assembly complexity, higher bill of materials cost, and increased spatial requirements inside the housing) and Use Phase (potential contact resistance or failure at connector interfaces due to tool vibration).

options_evaluated: Integrated lithium-ion pouch cell battery pack (non-removable)
Removable and standardized slide-on cylindrical Li-ion battery pack using cobalt-free chemistry
assessments.recommendation: Removable and standardized slide-on cylindrical Li-ion battery pack using cobalt-free chemistry
assessments.rationale: A removable battery pack is essential for design for recycling (d) as it allows safe battery extraction. Using cobalt-free chemistry (such as LFP) avoids substances of concern (f) and reduces the environmental footprint (m). Standardizing the pack across tool families reduces the overall material footprint (o) and allows the potential incorporation of used components (k) like reconditioned cells.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (cobalt-free chemistries like LFP have lower energy density, leading to a heavier tool or shorter runtime, which conflicts with lightweight design (t) and user convenience; a removable pack also increases overall weight and volume compared to an integrated pouch cell).
